answer: Stokes' Law states that the drag force $F_d$ on a sphere of radius $r$ moving with velocity $v$ through a fluid of viscosity $\eta$ is: $$F_d = 6\pi\eta r v$$ It applies to small spherical objects at low (laminar) speeds.
